structured.answer: I didn't decide anything; I'll ask the bank whether they owe me the notice about alternatives (the page says they must send one if over 15,000 ₪ sits in the עו"ש for a quarter) and whether I'm on the cheap basic fee track, and I'll ask my son. The page never told me how much my account actually costs.

stuck.why: It shows 5% a year and 74,044 ₪ for a current account, while the text says current accounts often pay no interest; I couldn't tell what it meant for me
I came to learn the cost and it says only 'לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע', with no amount
'אין בישראל ביטוח פיקדונות' frightened me about all my deposits, not only the עו"ש
Lock signs, 'שאלה פתוחה' and codes like TXI OQ11; I didn't understand them and stopped soon after

used: Title חשבון עובר ושב and the opening text
The 15,000 ₪ rule: after a quarter the bank must send a notice pointing to alternatives
Fee tracks: basic (1 teller + 10 online actions) and extended (10 + 50), which every bank must offer
The risks section about no deposit insurance and the 250,000 ₪ proposal
skimmed: Calculator inputs and the result rows (מס, דמי ניהול, ההפקדות שלכם)
unsure_meaning: TXI OQ11, TXI OQ7, BANK OQ9
The underlined '123 מקור / 123 חושב / 123 הוזנה' at the top
not_found: An actual amount for what my bank charges me each month
A plain answer on what is as safe as a deposit and pays more
Which bank pays interest on the עו"ש

findings.what: The cost section gives no number, only 'לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע'
The calculator assumes 5% return on a current account, which contradicts the text saying there's often no interest; the big 74,044 ₪ is misleading
'אין ביטוח פיקדונות' is alarming with no reassurance about ordinary deposits
findings.where: שווה לדעת and סיכונים, screens 3 and 5

findings.what: Codes like BANK-20 and TXI OQ11 mean nothing to me
Small grey text on a black background is hard to read
The alternative offered (קרן כספית) is never explained in plain words
A site I don't know (מקור); I'm not sure who stands behind it
The red box with 'שאלה פתוחה' made me back away
